# Handyeco - Edinburgh Handyman Services

> Professional 5-star rated handyman services in Edinburgh & Lothians. Specializing in flat-pack furniture assembly, TV wall mounting into Edinburgh tenement sandstone walls, silicone sealing, painting, and property maintenance.

Handyeco is a local, owner-operated property maintenance and handyman service based in Edinburgh, Scotland. Lead tradesperson Ekrem Guran provides upfront fixed pricing, guaranteed workmanship, and fast response times across all EH postcodes.

## Core Services & Website Sections

- [Handyeco Homepage](https://handyeco.co.uk/): Official website for Handyeco Edinburgh Handyman Services.
- [Handyman Services](https://handyeco.co.uk/#services): Complete catalogue of repair and assembly services including IKEA PAX assembly, TV wall mounting, silicone sealing, and door adjustments.
- [Flat-Pack & IKEA Assembly Edinburgh](https://handyeco.co.uk/services/flat-pack-assembly-edinburgh): Dedicated service guide, pricing, and FAQs for IKEA PAX wardrobes, sliding doors, and furniture assembly.
- [TV Wall Mounting into Stone Walls Edinburgh](https://handyeco.co.uk/services/tv-wall-mounting-edinburgh): Dedicated service guide for mounting TVs into Edinburgh tenement sandstone walls and stud partitions.
- [Bathroom & Shower Silicone Sealing Edinburgh](https://handyeco.co.uk/services/silicone-sealing-edinburgh): Anti-mould sanitary silicone replacement and bath/shower leak prevention.
- [Edinburgh Tenement Repairs & Odd Jobs](https://handyeco.co.uk/services/tenement-repairs-edinburgh): Door trimming after carpet fitting, curtain pole installation into masonry, and general tenement repairs.
- [Interior Painting & Decorating Edinburgh](https://handyeco.co.uk/services/painting-decorating-edinburgh): High quality room painting, woodwork glossing, and end-of-tenancy deposit-return repaints.
- [Kitchen Vinyl Wrapping Edinburgh](https://handyeco.co.uk/services/kitchen-vinyl-wrapping-edinburgh): Modern architectural wrap transformation for kitchen cabinets and worktops.
- [Garden Gate & Fence Repairs Edinburgh](https://handyeco.co.uk/services/garden-gate-fencing-edinburgh): Timber fence storm repairs, concrete post spurs, and garden gate fittings.
- [Morningside & Bruntsfield Handyman EH10](https://handyeco.co.uk/areas/morningside-handyman): Local 5-star handyman service for Morningside and Bruntsfield.
- [Leith & The Shore Handyman EH6](https://handyeco.co.uk/areas/leith-handyman): Local 5-star handyman service for Leith, The Shore, and Newhaven.
- [Stockbridge & New Town Handyman EH3/EH4](https://handyeco.co.uk/areas/stockbridge-new-town-handyman): Local 5-star handyman service for Stockbridge and New Town period homes.
- [Customer Reviews](https://handyeco.co.uk/#reviews): 75+ verified 5.0-star customer reviews from Edinburgh homeowners and tenants.
- [Service Coverage Areas](https://handyeco.co.uk/#areas): Edinburgh postcodes (EH1–EH17), Musselburgh (EH21), Dalkeith (EH22), and Livingston (EH54).
- [Work Gallery](https://handyeco.co.uk/#gallery): High-resolution before and after photos of local Edinburgh jobs.
